story: Until 2026-12-01 (4 days), options price NIFTY to move about ±1.1%, roughly 25,297 to 25,881. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 60% of the time.

Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap +0.1 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Puts usually cost more than this for NIFTY: against the past year the gap is very high, so less fear is priced than usual.

For the 2026-12-01 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 27,000 (+5.4% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 25,000 (-2.4%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
NIFTY has actually been moving about 1.05% a day this past month: on the high side for it against the past year.

iv.simple: Options on NIFTY are priced for moves of about 0.89% a day. That is normal for NIFTY compared with the past year.
iv.analyst: 30-day constant-maturity ATM IV 14.1%: 67th percentile of 1 year, 50th of all days since 2019-01-01. India VIX 16.55 (VIX includes the wings, so it usually prints above ATM IV).

vrp.simple: Options are cheap compared with how much NIFTY has actually been moving: they price 14.1% a year while the last month realised 16.6%.
vrp.analyst: IV30 - RV21 = -2.5 vol points, 17th percentile of the past year. Since 2019-01-01, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 68% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.

term.simple: Near and far options on NIFTY are priced about the same: nothing special is expected soon.

skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal +0.09 vol pts (front month), 98th percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.

realised.simple: NIFTY has actually been moving about 1.05% a day this past month: on the high side for it against the past year.
realised.analyst: RV21 16.6% (85th percentile of the past year), RV5 23.7%, RV63 14.9%; RV5/RV63 compression at the 89th percentile.

oi.analyst: Front-expiry PCR (OI) 0.56; all-expiry OI PCR at the 8th percentile of the past year. Today's change: calls +103,921,415, puts -4,320,680 (OI units, i.e. shares or index quantity). A high PCR in India mostly reflects put writing, so it is read as crowding, not as a signal.

futures.simple: NIFTY futures trade 92.1 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 4.1% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
futures.analyst: Near-month basis +92.1, annualised carry 4.1% (19th percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 5.9%). Last 5 sessions (price x OI, same contracts day to day): Long build-up, Short build-up, Long build-up, Long build-up, Long unwinding. Build-up labels describe what happened to positions; they do not say who is right.

move.analyst: ATM straddle / forward = 1.14% (forward 25,589.0). Scored on 1,956 days since 2019-01-01 against the official close on each expiry; a straddle is the market's mean absolute move, so about 57% inside is what a fair price would give.
